title: See your AI journey
intro: We will look at your accounts and habits, compare you to another profile, and ask for a tutorial.

steps.say: This is a dashboard with made-up data. Nothing is sent. We open the My AI Journey tab.
It lists the accounts and connectors in use, and what you do most.
Pick a profile to compare yourself to. We pick a power home user.
You see what is different, and one next step to consider.
Now ask for a tutorial based on your usage.
You get a short, free tutorial on one thing that would help you most.
That is the whole walkthrough. Press Replay to watch it again.
